# PC Keeper

> A comprehensive technology news and resource hub focused on IEEE Computer Society updates, quantum computing, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies.

PC Keeper aggregates news and information across multiple technology domains including quantum computing, AI, cybersecurity, and professional development. The site maintains monthly archives and hosts content related to IEEE events, conferences, and industry developments.

## Key Topics

- IEEE Computer Society
- Quantum Computing
- Cybersecurity
- Machine Learning
- Generative AI
- Computer Science
- Parallel Computing
- QCE 2024
- IEEE Awards
- Cloud Services
- Data Engineering
- Computer Graphics
- Professional Development
- Technology News
- Conferences and Symposiums

## Core & Homepage

- [PC Keeper Homepage](https://pc-keeper.tech): Homepage featuring IEEE Computer Society news and quantum computing events
